title: A library entry differing from an inactive part only by case or punctuation is hidden in the lookups
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-I2 is inactive at Staging Heavy Duty and is not stocked at Staging Lethbridge (QAPL-I1 cannot be used here because it is stocked at both locations). At Staging Heavy Duty: an open work order, an open estimate, an open part sale, the open purchase order and a received vendor bill (Delivery) with at least one line.
custom_steps:
1. Switch to Staging Lethbridge. Parts > Inventory > New Inventory Part: Description "QA look-alike", Part Number "qapl.i2", any Category and bin; Save.
  2. Switch to Staging Heavy Duty. Work order > a line > Add Part: type "QAPL", then replace it with "qapl.i2".
  3. Estimate > a line > Add Part: type "QAPL", then "qapl.i2".
  4. Part sale > Add Part: type "QAPL", then "qapl.i2".
  5. Purchase order: Add item on the open purchase order, part field: type "QAPL", then "qapl.i2".
  6. Received vendor bill (Delivery) > edit a line's part: type "QAPL", then "qapl.i2".
custom_expected:
1. The part is created at Staging Lethbridge. "qapl.i2" is not an exact match of any Part Library entry, so it gets its own entry "qapl.i2", which has no part stocked at Staging Heavy Duty.
  2. "QAPL": the active QAPL parts are offered; neither QAPL-I2 nor the Part Library entry "qapl.i2" is offered. "qapl.i2": no "qapl.i2" option and no special-order or "Create ... as a new part" offer; the lookup shows only "QAPL-I2 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."
  3. Same as step 2: the "qapl.i2" entry is not offered and the full number shows the QAPL-I2 inactive message.
  4. Same as step 2.
  5. Same as step 2.
  6. Same as step 2.
